claims.title: P2/P3 discovery advertises VCN 2.0.3 without harvest entries
claims.scope: ROM advertisement only; not physical availability.

claims.title: Examined driver skips 2.0.3; custom driver admission is unresolved
claims.scope: Saved source snapshot, not the installed community kernel.

claims.title: Firmware fallback and software harvest guard are traced
claims.scope: Reference fallback vcn_2_0_3.bin; registration may skip a harvested instance.

claims.title: BC250-compatible candidate firmware is not established
claims.scope: Navi10 and Van Gogh packages exist; valid packaging does not prove compatibility.

claims.title: Ordinary command 6 / type 13 loader route exists
claims.scope: t02 → F2 service 1 / 0x1007 → t28 loader; live success unobserved.

claims.title: PSP object/service binding and invocation chain is recovered
claims.scope: Successful static path; staged object identity and runtime success remain conditional.

claims.title: Type 13 requests usage 6; missing ID precedes usage enforcement
claims.scope: Missing ID returns ffff0008; matched enforced usage mismatch returns 80000205.

claims.title: Both candidates fail ID lookup in extracted P3 KDB fixtures
claims.scope: BL/TOS offline fixtures only; not a captured PSP completion.

claims.title: Both candidate signatures verify with matching reference keys
claims.scope: Actual OpenSSL results and corruption controls; not BC250 trust or execution.

claims.title: Staging-to-runtime KDB copy is traced; earlier producer is open
claims.scope: staging base + 784000 → analysis VA e25834; live byte identity unresolved.

claims.title: Examined Cyan table lacks VCN-enable callback
claims.scope: No proof that the actual community kernel uses this callback table.

claims.title: Row-6 children 23/22 are VCLK/DCLK
claims.scope: Independent metrics ABI link identifies software clock roles, not measured clocks.

claims.title: Row-6 parent/child protocols and cache bypasses are recovered
claims.scope: Ordered polls, not required edges; f714 cache can bypass. Physical bit meanings open.

claims.title: SSIP is preferred policy-copy inference; runtime semantics open
claims.scope: SSIP aligns all twenty worker slots and a second initializer; CONST.S supports the option. Index19 feeds child12/parent1. Shared opcode prevents raw-bit selection; runtime remains unvalidated.

claims.title: Reference memory windows and reset sequence are mapped
claims.scope: No demonstrated accepted image/address or successful BC250 programming.

claims.title: Actual BC250 VCPU-ready result is not established
claims.scope: Known reference UVD_STATUS & 2; no valid ready capture in seeded evidence.

claims.title: Actual VCN-executed ring result is not established
claims.scope: Known scratch9 CAFEDEAD → submitted DEADBEEF criterion; no execution result.

claims.title: Hardware media output is not established
claims.scope: Decode without software fallback and validate output; encode separately.

claims.title: Section/pair table is distinct from the authentication KDB
claims.scope: B=e5cbdc / E1177C; its ffff0008 cannot identify LOAD_IP_FW failure.

claims.title: Neighboring record paths do not normally populate section table B
claims.scope: Bounded negative result; producer, enable byte and configuration writers remain open.

claims.title: RSMU domain C management frame is distinct from VCN MMIO
claims.scope: Separate address spaces reported; discovery/LMA geometry aligns with saved work. RSMU offsets need primary evidence.

claims.title: BC250 reportedly grants zero VCN aperture windows in t24/t45
claims.scope: Requires hash-pinned complete table decode and independent interval/parser checks. Omission is not proof of runtime writability or state.

claims.title: 0900c004 reportedly names active-low VCN cold reset
claims.scope: Field identification and same-boot zero sample are unverified. Saved code requests late write 1; all-ones reads alone are not reset proof.

claims.title: SMU power already up and secure/LMA bypass paths are reported
claims.scope: One dom6 sample is insufficient for physical power. Master/path-specific filter behavior remains unvalidated.

claims.title: Type-13 completion requests the late management write after loader success
claims.scope: Host-context sentinel ffff selects 0900c004 <- 1; then 1f8a4 <- 1. SVC statuses can be discarded. Not proof of reset release.

claims.title: Stored P3 t24/t45 omit explicit frame-C targets and VCN-valued rows
claims.scope: Complete bounded inventory: 1405 / 144 pairs, zero frame-C target rows and zero VCN-range values. Only direct VCN targets: 1f8a4=0b and 1f820=185103. Not runtime grant absence.

claims.title: Final nonzero image status skips ordinary type-13 completion writes
claims.scope: 26 raw instruction/branch checks tie image error to omitted 0900c004 / 1f8a4 requests. Other writers and physical reset semantics remain open.

claims.title: Header lookup wrapper may attempt four 0x100-spaced headers
claims.scope: Byte+7f and word+18 control retries. One missing-ID lookup is not necessarily the final image failure; trace returned wrapper status.

claims.title: VCN3 headers support 1f8a4 as a filter-register candidate
claims.scope: Pinned VCN3 offset 29/segment 1 and privilege masks match candidate arithmetic. BC250 VCN2.0.3 equivalence unproven; 0b→01 keeps filter-enable set under this comparison schema.

claims.title: Upstream reports direct firmware provisioning without PSP loading
claims.scope: The September 30 report shows firmware BO copy and skipped PSP registration; VCPU execution, cache programming, rings and media remain unestablished.

claims.title: Upstream reports SMU prerequisite rejection and harvest/fuse leads
claims.scope: Messages 2A/2B reportedly return FD through the documented SMN mailbox. Exact handler identity, prerequisite cause, and fuse interpretation require validation; mailbox aliasing is unresolved.

claims.title: Boot-created t02 worker reaches the PSP command dispatcher
claims.scope: 2022AC -> 203558 -> 20243C: 64-byte ring frames, 16-dword advancement and wrapping. Runtime setup/submission remain unobserved.

claims.title: LOAD_IP_FW, SAVE/RESTORE and AUTOLOAD use distinct routes
claims.scope: Command 6 loads type 13; command 8 is SAVE/RESTORE; 21 sends message 1059 into the examined default-error path. No universal absence of startup inferred.

claims.title: Late-write context is traced back to the t02 ring worker
claims.scope: Worker literal 0000FFFF travels through message+44 to type-13 completion. It is request context, not hardware readiness; FFFFFFFF does not satisfy the full equality.

claims.title: VCN reads MMSCH state[19] after the late writes
claims.scope: Nonzero state[19] suppresses the mapped-buffer helper error after the writes. VCN marks slot 13; RLC uses 21/22. This is bookkeeping, not established hardware-ready state.

claims.title: Corrected Thumb decoding exposes section-driven mapped stores
claims.scope: Ordinary sections use SVC7C; 203/217 use direct pointers; cached section210 uses SVC7D page mapping and a mapped store. Runtime table/enable producers remain unresolved.

claims.title: Loader exits before PGFSM and omits a later CGC mode clear
claims.scope: All-ones POWER_STATUS returns before local programming. The reachable later path omits CGC_CTRL clear 7FFFF800 including REGS_MODE and SUVD updates. Not a demonstrated clamp cause.

claims.title: Worker gate and selector conventions constrain clock application
claims.scope: Feature13 installs callback24; equal current/requested states skip application. Setter does not advance the gate; setter/read selectors differ by one and readers return caches.

claims.title: Refined Ghidra export recovers additional functions and calls
claims.scope: 1290 -> 1297 functions; halt_baddata-affected functions 97 -> 7; 158 added direct edges among shared entries. Experimental decoding and remaining truncations are recorded.

claims.title: Sixteen selected offline contribution checks pass
claims.scope: Fresh rerun preserves outputs, script/core-input hashes and exit codes. Source checks, arithmetic, fixtures and crypto controls have separate scope; no hardware operations.

claims.title: Navi12 late completion has a checked address-publication handshake
claims.scope: Comparison image sends high/low address words, commands1/2, requires exact response80000001; VCN can republish the MMSCH shared record. BC250 applicability remains open.

claims.title: Five late PSP registers are captured runtime state for replay
claims.scope: 1F8C4..1F8D4 values are captured and restored. Initial zero words are not established cold-start constants; write requests do not establish accepted stores.
